name: Weak / Default / Empty Credentials
attack_scenario: a default, empty, or trivially guessable credential (admin123, empty password, trust auth) ships to production, so an attacker logs in by guessing or by knowing the well-known default
negative_test_hint: try "admin:admin" (and the vendor default) against the deployed service and assert it is rejected and not present in code or config

exemplar.compliant: DB_PASSWORD = os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"]   # required, no weak default; enforce a strong-password policy
exemplar.explanation: never ship default/empty/guessable credentials; require a strong secret from the environment and fail closed if unset
